messages:
jon_sales: Heads up — Alma from Octavo on a POC. Dedicated GPU pool provisioning keeps failing with backoff/429s when we try to reserve egress IPs. CC @maria_cs @kevin_platform

alma_customer: Here's what we're seeing from our side: "error: quota_exceeded: EIP quota" when creating pool. Tried twice. Region: us-west2, AZ: us-west2a. Requesting 8 A100s.

maria_cs: Thanks. Can you paste the full error dump and the terraform snippet you used? Are you using az_affinity=preferred or required?

alma_customer: snippet below:
```
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "octavo" {
  region = "us-west2"
  az_affinity = "preferred"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  count = 8
  static_ips = true
}
```

jon_sales: We saw similar with another customer — provider returns ALLOC_CONSTRAINED or rate-limits EIP creations. Also note we have a bug: when static_ips=true and IP allocation fails, we currently don't auto-fallback to ephemeral egress.

kevin_platform: On it. 429 from provider almost always either quota (EIP limit) or rate limit. Also our reservation-service retried aggressively, causing a retry storm. Can you confirm provider error code? Any terraform provider version?

alma_customer: provider error: "ALLOC_CONSTRAINED" then 429s. Using provider v3.2.1. Terraform shows plan applied then failed on resource create.

sophia_sre: I see a spike from our side: ~120 provisioning ops/min for Octavo org in us-west2 between 11:02–11:04. That's likely triggering provider rate limits and our internal retries amplify it.

kevin_platform: Short-term workaround: set static_ips=false (use ephemeral egress) or split into two pools across AZs (4 + 4) to avoid single-AZ allocation limits. Long-term: I'll patch reservation-service to fall back when EIP allocation fails.

maria_cs: Customer security requires static egress IPs for firewall rules. If we can't provide static IPs, we might lose the POC. Can Sales/Eng expedite a manual NAT mapping?

jon_sales: Confirmed — security says fixed egress IPs needed. @kevin_platform can we create NAT GW elastic IPs and map nodes post-provisioning? Also what's impact on pricing/discount if we change config for POC?

kevin_platform: I can try manual NAT creation and map after nodes up, but this still requires provider EIP quota. If quota is the blocker we should escalate to provider support. I'm going to push a small hotfix to reservation-service: if EIP allocation fails with ALLOC_CONSTRAINED, mark pool as 'ephemeral-egress' and notify admins instead of retrying. That will unblock POC while we sort EIPs with provider.

sre-bot: deploy started: reservation-service v1.8.3-hotfix (kevin_platform)

sophia_sre: I'll also throttle our provisioning concurrency per-org to reduce retry storms. Opening a provider support ticket for EIP quota increase as well.

jon_sales: I'll relay the temporary exception to Alma and the security team and confirm demo timing.

alma_customer: Temporary exception acceptable for demo, but need written note and timeline for permanent static IPs.

kevin_platform: Note — if low-latency cache requires AZ affinity, we can keep az_affinity but still use ephemeral egress. I'm pushing patch to staging now.

maria_cs: Plan: deploy hotfix, reprovision pool with ephemeral egress at 13:00 PT if staging looks good. @alma_customer is 13:00 PT OK?

alma_customer: 13:00 PT works. Please keep me posted.

kevin_platform: Patch deployed to staging, monitoring logs. Will update when we attempt reprovision.

sophia_sre: Provider ticket opened: INC-REDWOOD-4387. Monitoring quotas and EIP allocation.

jon_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update Octavo security and legal, and confirm pricing concession for the workaround.

maria_cs: Closing loop after reprovision. If anything else comes up ping #oncall.

alma_customer: Thanks team :pray:
